scope: Existing internal validation only; 50 tracks, 5 compositions; no outer/Locked12 evaluation. Observational, not causal.

definitions.k: Number of assigned new annotated attacks; not the number of sounding notes. Original 0..6 labels unchanged.
definitions.intervals: Half-open [onset, offset), in rounded original-audio samples. Offsets and strings from note_midi annotations.
definitions.near_simultaneous: All assigned onsets span <=10 ms; timing sensitivity also at 5,20,30,40 ms.
definitions.overlap: Assigned notes have overlapping duration intervals; all-current overlap means positive common interval across all K.
definitions.carried: A note outside the assigned group starts strictly before the earliest assigned onset and ends strictly after it; includes unassigned annotations.
definitions.old_carried: Same, additionally started at least 20 ms earlier; age sensitivity 0,20,50,100 ms.
definitions.standardization: Identical pooled row weights for strata containing at least 5 examples on each side; unsupported rows excluded and enumerated. This does not establish causality.
definitions.previous_gap_bins: Previous foreign onset gap: no previous, [0,20),[20,50),[50,100),[100,200),[200,500),>=500 ms. Rounded sample boundaries.

limitations: The original candidate-conditioned validation is not a balanced overlap/non-overlap benchmark.
K is attack count. A correct K does not demonstrate correct pitch identity or note duration detection.
Annotated offsets are a proxy for sounding duration; actual resonances may extend beyond annotations.
This is one completed model pair, one seed, an already inspected internal split, and only five compositions.
Event rows in one track are correlated; no row-independent statistical significance is asserted.
Annotations outside any candidate assignment are not counted as missed notes in this Exact-K score.
